VPP-NEA-20260817.claim: NEA describes virtual power plants as the aggregation/control layer for distributed storage, charging, generation and flexible loads, with participation in peak-shaving, frequency, demand-response and energy markets; current regional markets already admit VPP resources.

VPP-NEA-20260427.claim: NEA reported 470 virtual-power-plant projects by end-2025 and tested maximum regulation capability of 16.85 million kW, showing a deployed aggregation layer rather than an unowned matching edge.

CARBON-SAMR-20260606.claim: SAMR/CNCA approved a CNAS accreditation regime for product-carbon-footprint verification institutions covering organization qualification, personnel competence, verification norms and recognition procedures.

CARBON-SAMR-20260914.claim: SAMR reports a national product-carbon-footprint certification pilot with general rules, 17 product-specific rules and 26 selected certification institutions, making recognized verification/certification a governed service rail.

PATENT-MOE-20260403.claim: MOE's 2026 university patent commercialization action directs continued expansion of the China University Science and Technology Achievement Trading Platform with patent search, demand publishing, evaluation, intelligent matching and transaction brokerage.

PATENT-CNIPA-20260325.claim: CNIPA reports a nationwide inventory of 1.349 million university/research patents, 680,000 promising invention patents and matching with 460,000 enterprises, alongside sharply growing transfer/licensing activity.

LOWALT-SIP-20260715.claim: Suzhou Industrial Park brought together 11 enterprises needing low-altitude transport solutions and six service providers specifically to understand demand and facilitate supply-demand matching.

LOWALT-MSA-20260618.claim: Nanjing Maritime Safety Administration reports a normal-operation waterborne drone logistics project proceeding through safety-operation filing and full-process government service, showing that lawful execution depends on regulated operating capability rather than matching alone.

DATA-NDA-20260911.claim: The National Data Administration launched the national data-property registration service and designated Beijing, Shanghai and Shenzhen data exchanges as registration institutions, providing a standardized rights and verification rail.

DATA-BEIJING-20260709.claim: Beijing's 2026 public-data authorized-operation rules define implementation and authorized operating institutions, require lawful authorization and make qualified operators responsible for developing public data resources and fairly providing data products/services.

special_observation.observation: Suzhou Industrial Park directly observed 11 demand enterprises and six low-altitude service providers in a supply-demand matching event.
special_observation.boundary: The observation proves bilateral motion and a matching need, but not operator control of flight/site/safety/filing action gates.

conclusion: All five fields are closed at the initial attraction layer because decisive execution or acceptance remains inside current regulated, accredited, platform or infrastructure control surfaces.
